text:
Aisha R.: Quick brief 11 need a compact launch kit for the APAC webinar + the benchmark blog post. Goal: one hero (landscape + square), three sticker icons, benchmark chart (static + tiny GIF), email banner, and localized sticker variants (ES/JPN). Can design take?
Connor L.: Yep. I can do the hero + chart. For the chart I need the raw CSV of the benchmark numbers (cost per 1k tokens across models/hardware). Who has that?
Aisha R.: Uploading dataset to the marketing drive in 10. Also need a small visual badge that says "APAC Webinar" and a timezone note (UTC+8) for the landing CTA.
Sam (CreativeOps): Export specs: landscape PNG 1600x900, square 1200x1200, stickers 1080x1080, email banner 600x200. SVG, and a 3-frame GIF for the sparkline. Alt text + short screen-reader lines required for each.
Gabi S.: Localization request: Spanish + Japanese for the three stickers and headline. Keep copy <18 chars for stickers to avoid truncation. Also: font licensing check for JP glyphs.
legal-bot: Automated: Any performance claims (e.g., "sub-50ms") need a reference note attached in Figma or be phrased as "typical" or "median". Please add the benchmark methodology link to component notes.
Connor L.: Noted. Ill label callouts as "typical p95" unless legal approves otherwise. Also planning a small cost-savings callout: "up to 90% cheaper"  will include a tooltip that links to the raw CSV.
Sam (CreativeOps): Timeline? I can get first-pass exports in 48-72 hours if Figma is up. Ill reserve Thurs AM export slot.
Aisha R.: Target: first pass in 72 hours, localization pass within 5 business days. Please escalate blockers to me or @Gabi.
Gabi S.: For JP: prefer Noto Sans JP; confirm with fonts team. Will coordinate. Also request a light/dark variant for the hero (dark for Twitter card).
Connor L.: Chart notes: include axis labels, small legend, and a callout bubble for the operating point we want to highlight. Will post the Figma when sketches are up.
Sam (CreativeOps): Pro tip: keep sticker text to 2 lines max. For GIF sparkline keep file <500kb.
legal-bot: Reminder: add claim source URL in Figma notes and ping legal for final sign-off before publish.
Aisha R.: Thanks. When you upload the Figma link here I'll run a 2-hour review with Growth + Sales. If approved, Sam will finalize exports and send the PDF one-pager for SDRs. :white_check_mark: 
Connor L.: Uploading Figma now: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/apac-mini-launch-kit
Sam (CreativeOps): Got it. Reserving export time Thu 09:00. Will include alt text and titles for accessibility.
Gabi S.: Adding localization files to the same Figma page under "i18n" frames. Also adding a small badge variant with UTC+8.
Aisha R.: Perfect  appreciate the quick turnaround. Ping me if legal blocks any claims. :rocket:
